defects.defect: Death/hospice discharges were filtered after encoding and the train/test split, so the split and encoded columns didn't match the intended population.
defects.fix: Filter moved before get_dummies and the split; model retrained and docs updated.

defects.defect: requirements.txt was saved as UTF-16, a fragile encoding for pip.
defects.fix: Rewritten as UTF-8 with pinned pandas/numpy/scikit-learn/joblib.

defects.defect: Render deploy failed: .python-version 3.11.2 isn't available on Render.
defects.found_by: Render build log (reported by the user)

defects.defect: The API sent 14 fields but the model used 110 columns; the other 59 were zero-filled, silently assuming values such as admission type 0, glucose '>200' and A1C '>7'.
defects.found_by: Code review; quantified with a three-way comparison on the test set
defects.fix: Model retrained on the 14 API fields (AUC 0.6642), so every input is user-entered.

defects.defect: Unknown or misspelled categories (e.g. gender 'Femle') were silently scored as the baseline category.
defects.fix: Validation against training values; 422 invalid_category with the allowed values.

defects.defect: The API returned a score for expired/hospice discharge codes; only the Streamlit form blocked them.
defects.fix: 422 out_of_scope at the API for codes 11, 13, 14, 19, 20, 21.

defects.defect: Appending to .gitignore without a trailing newline produced 'clean_diabetic_data.csv.env', which would have un-ignored the 17 MB dataset.
defects.found_by: Reviewing the command output before staging
defects.fix: .gitignore rewritten; confirmed with git check-ignore. Never committed.

defects.defect: The only risk output was high_risk (score > 0.5), which just 72 of 19,802 test encounters reach.
defects.fix: Percentile-based Low/Moderate/High tiers with real tier readmission rates.

defects.defect: The quote checker inserted spaces at inline HTML tags, so a correct PSNet quote was reported missing.
defects.fix: Spaces added only at block-level tags; all 41 quotes verified.

defects.defect: The dosing filter matched the bare word 'dose': it would refuse 'Why do wrong doses happen at discharge?' and flag a vetted knowledge-base summary.
defects.fix: Patterns narrowed to dose requests; regression tests for allowed questions.

defects.defect: Factor linking by text matched 'Primary diagnosis' to 'primary care'; the top factor got only background items; DKA education and a dataset-scope note were surfaced for unrelated patients.
defects.found_by: Inspecting real assistant output for three patients
defects.fix: Links require a shared topic tag, one recommendation per factor first; two excerpt tags removed.

defects.defect: After 'Back to queue', the table kept the previous row selection, so clicking that row again deselected it and nothing opened.
defects.found_by: Headless-browser run (AppTest can't click table rows)
defects.fix: Fresh table key after each visit.

defects.defect: Some Moderate patients read 'below the average readmission rate' because the Moderate tier starts at the median (10.1%), below the 11.2% average.
defects.fix: Always 'about N x the average'; Moderate dashboards explain where the tier starts.

defects.defect: Risk card said 'Higher than about 100% of test-set patients'; logo text clipped; last queue column cut off.
defects.fix: 'Among the top 1% of test-set scores'; wider logo; narrower queue columns.

defects.defect: The README described the Render API as 'always-on' (added in be989be). The claim disappeared when the architecture diagram was rewritten in d3b99b9, but the free tier's wake-up delay was never documented; the cold-start test measured a 71.5 s first response.
defects.fix: README limitation added: the first request after the service has been idle can take about a minute.

corrected_tests.problem: Assumed diag_2_group was created before diag_3_group, so its column order didn't match the saved model and the check failed.
corrected_tests.correction: Followed the notebook's real cell order; the saved model then matched (AUC 0.6631).

corrected_tests.problem: Asserted the exact two-key /predict response; Stage 2 intentionally added fields.
corrected_tests.correction: Checks the original fields and values are unchanged and the new keys are additions.

corrected_tests.problem: The earlier test asserted every excerpt stays 'pending' forever, which would fail as soon as a reviewer approves one.
corrected_tests.correction: Replaced with an invariant: pending has no review record; approved names its reviewer; rejected is recorded.

corrected_tests.problem: Assumed a query would still return results after rejecting every matching excerpt (the code correctly returned none).
corrected_tests.correction: Compares the same query before and after rejection.

corrected_tests.problem: The fake requests.post/get didn't accept the headers argument once the app sent X-API-Key.
corrected_tests.correction: Fixture forwards headers to the in-process API.

corrected_tests.problem: Assertions on wording that changed by design: 'raises/lowers' to 'higher/lower' (d3b99b9), 'below the average' to 'about N x' (6914aae), headline moved into the HTML risk card (4cc8b16).
corrected_tests.correction: Updated to the new specified wording; these were spec changes, not defects.

corrected_tests.problem: Button match failed on icon ligature text, the dropdown selector didn't match Streamlit 1.62, and the tier-filter toggle cleared every tier.
corrected_tests.correction: Match by contained text, use Streamlit test IDs with real mouse clicks, toggle only the tiers to hide.

corrected_tests.test: Live two-theme check of the polish pass (scratch script)
corrected_tests.problem: Could not reconnect to a second headless Chrome instance; the run was interrupted before both themes were checked on the live app.
corrected_tests.correction: Not completed. Light mode was confirmed on the live app (new sidebar navigation present); both themes were verified locally with screenshots.
